Welcome to Apex Tutorial Bettiah. Our sole academic commitment is providing world-class classroom coaching exclusively for Class 11th & 12th Science students preparing for Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) examinations.

We believe that strict discipline, early morning 6:00 AM batch routines, and continuous weekly test evaluations build the mental focus and confidence necessary for achieving 90%+ scores in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology.

Academic Discipline Pillars

Peaceful Atmosphere & Classroom Rules

At Apex Tutorial, we maintain a quiet, highly disciplined environment designed specifically for BSEB Class 11th & 12th Science students preparing for board exams.

Strict Punctuality

Batches start sharp at 6:00 AM. Punctuality is strictly enforced to maintain academic discipline.

Silent & Focused Learning Zone

Classrooms are designed for a quiet, distraction-free environment conducive to deep study.

Mandatory Weekly Tests

Compulsory weekly evaluation tests based strictly on the BSEB exam pattern.

Personalized Guidance

Faculty dedicated time after lectures for resolving individual student doubts.

Why 6:00 AM Early Morning Batches?

Early morning classes allow students to attend lectures with fresh mental energy, complete coaching early, and dedicate full day hours to self-study revision for Bihar Board examinations.
